journey: Freeze a read-only capability, data, and failure baseline.

protocol.blueQuestion: What read-only evidence or governance rule is needed before the first user-facing slice can be trusted?
protocol.redQuestion: Does the requirement invoke AI backfill, create a write authority, activate UI, or mutate canon?
protocol.rule: RP0 may observe, classify, freeze fixtures, and govern future releases; it cannot claim product capability or perform semantic writes.

moved.title: 预览式回填
moved.reason: AI backfill and candidate acceptance mutate semantic assets; RP0 is strictly read-only, while V5 first owns summary/person/fact adoption and V6 revalidates obligation extraction.

conclusion: RP0 is a governance baseline, not a user release; AI backfill moves to V5/V6, while observation/evaluation guards and the project-durability contract are frozen before later slices depend on recoverability. Current product backup implementation remains unverified.
